doc:
### PROPOSAL-13 — Brutalist Raw - **slug**: `brutalist` - **Vibe**: Stark, unapologetic raw HTML — heavy black borders, monospace everywhere, hard offset shadows, zero rounding. - **Best for**: Agency publishing logs and power-user tables — a "no chrome, just data" aesthetic. Adjectives: stark, honest, confrontational. - **Palette** (light theme, `is_dark: false`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#f5f5f0` | Off-white raw canvas | | `--bg-surface` | `#ffffff` | Card and panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#e8e8e0` | Hover/raised fills | | `--border-subtle` | `#c9c9c0` | Fine grey hairlines | | `--border-default` | `#000000` | Heavy black borders (2-3px) | | `--border-focus` | `#0000ff` | Raw-blue focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#000000` | Pure black text | | `--text-secondary` | `#1a1a1a` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#55554e` | Captions, helper text | | `--color-action` | `#000000` | Black primary action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#333333` | Action hover (dark grey) | | `--color-earnings` | `#007a3d` | Print-green earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#006331` | Earnings hover (deeper green) | | `--color-automation` | `#0000ff` | Raw-blue automation accents | | `--color-alert` | `#b45309` | Amber-brown warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#c00000` | Raw-red failed states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)` | Grey tint behind action icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(0, 122, 61, 0.08)` | Green tint behind earnings icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(0, 0, 255, 0.08)` | Blue tint behind automation icons | - **Typography**: Mono everything — display, sans, and mono all use `"Space Mono", "Courier New", ui-monospace, monospace`. Display at 700, body at 400-700, uppercase labels at `letter-spacing: 0.04em`. Numerals `tabular-nums`. Nothing decorative; every glyph is typewriter-honest. - **Radii & Borders**: `border-radius: 0` everywhere. Borders are 2-3px solid black (`--border-default`); hairlines are 1px. Shadows are hard offsets (`4px 4px 0 0 #000`) with zero blur. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Square, 3px black border, solid black fill with white text; hover inverts (white fill, black text) and shifts the offset shadow. Secondary = white with 3px border. Focus = 3px `#0000ff` outline with a 2px gap. - **Cards**: White with 3px black border and a hard 6px black offset shadow; header bar is a solid black strip with white mono text. No gradients, no glows. - **Badges/Status**: Square mono chips with 2px black border; publishing = blinking black square; published = green text chip; failed = red text chip. No pills. - **Tables**: Stark 1px grid with a thick black header bar (white text); row hover = 4px black left rule. All values mono and aligned. - **Forms/Inputs**: 2px black border, no rounding; focus = 3px black border plus a blue offset. Labels are uppercase mono. - **Loading**: A blinking block cursor on a `LOADING...` line, or a hard black square bar sweeping; determinate = solid black bar filling from left. - **Signature detail**: Heavy black outlines + hard offset shadows + mono-everything and zero rounding — it looks like a 1996 default stylesheet with intent. - **Motion & Animation**: Instant — 0-60ms linear; elements hard-cut in with no fade. Hover states snap; Turbo Stream inserts appear as abrupt line insertions. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
EARNINGS / 30D $12,480 +14.2%
```
